title: Digital Glossary — terms of art

prov.label: SIMULATED · would derive from: Confluence domain glossary + Sterling data dictionary + retail ops training manuals

rows: Buy Online, Pickup In Store — order picked and staged at the customer's chosen store; ≈34% of online orders
Buy Online, Ship to Store — DC ships to the store for customer pickup when the store has no stock
Ship-from-Store — store acts as a mini-DC, picking and parcel-shipping online orders; 1,900 stores enabled
Available-to-Promise — sellable quantity per node: on-hand minus safety stock minus open reservations
Sterling unit of work: an order slice committed to one fulfillment node for execution
Store on-hand minus safety stock and shrink buffer — the quantity a pick task may claim
A consumer-facing brand storefront; Hartwell operates 4 banners on one shared digital platform
Processor-issued PAN surrogate (CyberSource); raw card numbers never enter Hartwell systems
Goodwill credit or partial refund issued by customer care outside the standard returns flow
A Mirakl vendor's sellable listing against a catalog product — the vendor owns price and quantity
SKU = sellable unit (≈1.2M online); Item = the merchandising master record a SKU derives from
Legacy guided-navigation attribute still powering category page filters during the ES migration
